<thought>To retrieve the retrosynthetic template that creates a sulfonamide (S–N bond formation) we can search the template catalog specifying that the forward reaction forms a sulfonamide functional group and creates an S‑N bond. This should return the appropriate template_id and its SMARTS, which we can then map to obtain the mapped reaction SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/CNc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamide"],
    "bonds_formed": ["S-N"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
